priority_updates.title: Who will receive the longest prison sentence at the trial over the July 2023 burglary of Gianluigi Donnarumma's Paris home?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Paris Criminal Court's judgment, as documented by the court or reliable contemporaneous reporting. Resolution Conditions : Identify the defendant receiving the longest total prison sentence in the trial verdict delivered by September 30, 2026. Compare sentences actually imposed, including any suspended portions, rather than sentences requested by prosecutors. Later appeals do not affect resolution. Accepted Answer Format : The defendant's name as publicly reported.

priority_updates.title: Which stadium will UEFA select to host the 2029 men's Champions League final?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : UEFA's official announcement awarding hosting rights for the 2029 men's Champions League final, or reliable contemporaneous reporting of that announcement. Resolution Date : Resolve when UEFA publicly announces its venue selection. Subsequent venue changes will not alter the answer. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the selected stadium.
